items.title: Joe Segal — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I booked him mostly because of John Gilmore and Pat Patrick on the band.

ctx.x: [Laughs] Did he do well when you booked him?
Yeah, yeah. I booked him mostly because of John Gilmore and Pat Patrick on the band.
